title: NFLPA has not decided whether (or how) to challenge the NFL's position on Brendan Sorsby

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: NFLPA has not decided whether (or how) to challenge the NFL's position on Brendan Sorsby
sources.description: After the NFL decided not to allow quarterback Brendan Sorsby into the supplemental draft, lawyer Jeffrey Kessler said he plans to immediately raise the alleged Collective Bargaining Agreement violation with the NFL Players Association.
